notes.title: 85% DISCOUNT!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41129921/5e4647d73a2981bebfd59804d8859b5e2a01b433.png[/img]

We're thrilled to announce that Morbid Inhale is participating in Steam's Spring Sale!

Nature is awakening, and hordes of zombies that you'll have to fight come with it.

Don't miss out on the opportunity to buy the game with an 85% discount!
Treat yourself and your friends to a dynamic shooter where an astronaut mows down zombies like they're fresh spring grass.
Immerse yourself in the hero's adventures and follow him on his journey from complete despair to salvation. Keep in mind! This path will require you to kill thousands of zombies.

notes.title: 80% DISCOUNT!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41129921/01c6804b1f496471dc5e71b23020c8427a4f3207.png[/img]

Ho-Ho-Ho!
We're thrilled to announce that Morbid Inhale is participating in Steam's Winter Sale!

Winter is the perfect time to warm up with the Fire Ring and spread some heat to the surrounding zombies with the Fire Bullets, and time seems to be in Slow Motion in anticipation of the holidays.

Don't miss out on the opportunity to buy the game with an 80% discount!
Treat yourself and your friends to an awesome, dynamic shooter where a cosmonaut mows down hordes of zombies like they're cabbage.
Immerse yourself in the hero's adventures and follow him on his journey from complete despair to salvation. Keep in mind! This path will require you to kill thousands of zombies.
